scripts.db:up: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml --project-directory .. up -d --wait db && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:migrate:test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml --project-directory .. exec -T db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ename_dev WITH (FORCE); CREATE DATABASE ename_dev;" && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:reset:test: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml --project-directory .. exec -T db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ename_test WITH (FORCE); CREATE DATABASE ename_test;" && npm run db:migrate:test
scripts.db:dump: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml --project-directory .. exec -T db pg_dump -U postgres -d ename_dev --schema-only --no-owner --no-privileges --restrict-key=enameschemadump > ../database/schema.sql
scripts.db:status: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml --project-directory .. exec -T db psql -U postgres -d ename_dev -c "SELECT version, name, applied_at FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY version"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format && npm run test
